title: Plain `cargo check` is rejected on a contract crate
summary: On a contract crate, plain `cargo check` (host target) fails with near-sdk's guard even though `cargo test` works, because the guard is only lifted by the unit-testing feature or by the on-chain build environment that cargo-near sets up.

symptoms.pattern: Use `cargo near build` instead of `cargo build`

steps: Use `cargo near check` to type-check a contract (add `--clippy` for lints). It uses the same environment as `cargo near build`.
Keep using `cargo test` for unit tests.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): `cargo check` on the contract crate failed with this message while `cargo test --lib` passed. Whether editors (rust-analyzer) surface it was not tested.
